summary_markdown:
The process for analyzing movement direction and demographic data was updated. Previously, the approach involved comparing 7 days of mall data with 60 days of city data. The new methodology requires checking every trip between both locations daily over the last 30 days, which significantly improved data quality despite reducing the overall volume of records.

[me] provided a SQL query to retrieve aggregated device demography data for a specific date.

Key requirements discussed included providing sample size broken down by residential area and target location.
decisions: The analysis will now check every trip between both locations daily over the last 30 days.
action_items: [p1] to test the provided data tomorrow, followed by a call.
